calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jan-19-2010 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of an Adult and of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioners Xiuli He and Yue Bing Chen were present in pro per as Guardians ad litem for the minor, Wanyong Chen.
Petitioner Xiuli He was also present for her own change of name.
Petitioners were placed under oath and examined.
Shuna Lei was placed under oath and served as Cantonese speaking interpreter for petitioners.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: Shirley Xiuli He.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minor to: Wueenie Wanyong Chen.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
